source_full_text: Here he found a quiet place in which to rest his bruised and battered limbs and to think over his many misfortunes. He fell asleep fully determined to give up trying to be great, But to lead the life of an honest workman. Next morning he set to work to fulfil his good resolutions. He sold his little box to a jeweller for a good price, Bought a house and opened a workshop.
